title: SAGE Source Adapter Configuration
description: Defines which source adapters are enabled for a vault and their configurations. Each adapter reads a native format and produces an indexable projection (structured text with heading hierarchy). See SAGE Architecture Reference Sections 3.4.1 through 3.4.4.

adapters.description: Enabled source adapters for this vault. Order is not significant; adapter selection is by source_type match.

source_type.description: The source format this adapter handles. Must match a valid source_type value in the SAGE Document object model.

enabled.description: Whether this adapter is active for this vault.

config.description: Adapter-specific configuration. Structure varies by source_type.

watch_paths.description: Directories to watch for new or changed files of this source type. Paths are absolute or relative to the vault's storage_root.

file_extensions.description: File extensions that trigger this adapter (e.g., ['.md'], ['.docx']). Used by the file watcher and bulk ingestion.

heading_style_map.description: For docx adapter: maps Word paragraph style names to heading levels in the projection. Default uses standard Heading 1 through Heading 9.

ocr_enabled.description: For pdf adapter: whether to attempt OCR on image-only pages. Phase 1 does not support OCR.
